lead: Test build 0.8.25c (CI run 39130131007). New in this round: (1) the LOAD menu has the original's "Revert to" and "Recently Used" (E220); (2) Personal Libraries has "Create Empty Library" with the original's save dialog (E217); (3) menus look like the original's on Windows 10: one column in Windows' modern look, columns in the older look, with separator lines (E219); (4) projects made with the original's VST3 plug-in open (second entry "TI Revive Virus Control (original projects)", already tested: E222, E223); (5) the plug-in reports version 0.8.25 (was 0.8.23). The menu look and Revert/Recently Used are the same code on every system, so they are tested on Linux only (user decision); the save dialog is per system, so the VM and the Mac have one item for it. The real PC is not part of this round. Mark each item, add a note where something looks different, then copy the results at the bottom into the chat. When all pass, 0.8.25 is released.
rules: Order: Linux first (the Virus is on this PC), then the Windows 11 VM, then macOS. Close the DAW before the Virus moves.

sections.title: Linux
sections.where: REAPER via pw-jack, Virus on this PC
prep: Claude installs 0.8.25c (replaces the dev build in ~/.vst3; you may be asked for sudo for the udev rule). Logging is on. Restart REAPER if it was open.
notes: Exports in REAPER: File > Render, Source Master mix, Render speed Full-speed offline.

items.title: Menus look like the original's on Windows 10
steps: Click LOAD on part 1: a one-column menu with a light band on the left, 22 px rows, ">" for submenus, and a thin separator line before the device entry once a patch was loaded.
Open Personal Libraries (a separator before Create Empty Library) and a short value list (e.g. the filter mode menu): the current value has a tick on a light blue square.
Open the Wavetable list (right click on the big ring knob on the OSC page): 4 columns in the older look, as before.
items.expect: one-column menus in the modern look, menus with columns in the older look, hover is a light blue row, no drawing errors.

items.title: Revert to and Recently Used
steps: Part 1: load three different patches from LOAD one after another, then the first one again; then double-click a fourth patch in the BROWSER page.
LOAD > Recently Used: newest first (the browser patch on top), the patch you loaded twice only once. "Revert to" names the patch before the last load.
Turn a knob a bit, choose Revert to: the previous patch comes back; LOAD again: Revert now names the edited patch; choose it: your knob change is back.
Choose an entry from Recently Used: it loads, the list keeps its order. Part 2's LOAD menu has its own (empty) list.
items.expect: as described; nothing is stored in the Virus or in the project (a new project starts with empty lists).

items.title: Create Empty Library (zenity dialog)
steps: Open the plug-in, click LOAD on part 1 > Personal Libraries: below a separator line is Create Empty Library. Choose it.
A save dialog opens titled "Save empty library as...", in the patches folder (~/Dokumente/Access Music/Virus TI/Patches), with the name "New Library.mid". Click Save/OK.

Open LOAD > Personal Libraries again: "New Library" is listed. SAVE part 1 into it (SAVE > Personal Libraries > New Library > 000 (new)), then LOAD > Personal Libraries > New Library shows that patch.
Once more Create Empty Library, this time Cancel: no new file. Afterwards delete New Library.mid from the folder.
items.expect: the dialog as described, the library listed at once, saving into it works, Cancel creates nothing, no crash.
